body_html:
Writers thrive on the power of observation.

Look up. The sky is its own canvas of wonder.  Imagine this: we all share the same sky, just different parts of it at different times of day. Your sky is part of my sky, and mine, is part of yours.

For today’s prompt, gaze up at the sky, day or night or somewhere in-between, and take notice. We suggest you find a nice plot of ground to lay back on and then just become quiet. Looking, wondering, wandering at the expanse above you. How does the sky inform your world?

Adapted From: https://dailyconnector.com/2019/07/18/clmooc-feldgang-variations-the-open-sky/
